content: Citation faithfulness: correctness != faithfulness (arXiv 2412.18004) - a citation can point at a document that happens to contain the fact while the model actually generated it from parametric memory. Metrics: NLI-based claim decomposition (entailed/neutral/contradicted, DeBERTa), Unsupported Sentence Ratio (USR) as cheap proxy, citation precision/recall. Inline citation generation during answer generation (not post-hoc assignment) is a necessary condition for faithfulness. Failure modes: claim extraction errors, NLI domain mismatch, citation hallucination (right fact, wrong attribution).
